The present Petition has been filed by the Petitioners under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking issuance of an appropriate writ for declaring the acquisition proceedings in respect of the subject land, stated to be belonging to the Petitioners, to have lapsed in view of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

opennyai_summary.decision:
3. Last and final opportunity of four weeks is granted to the LAC to file the counter affidavit as it is seen that the counter affidavit was directed to be filed way back and the LAC was granted an opportunity to file the same vide order dated 4th September, 2023 as well.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
4. Considering this position, if the counter affidavit is not filed within two weeks, costs of Rs.10,000/- shall be paid by the LAC to the Petitioners and only then counter affidavit shall be taken on record.
Rejoinder thereto be filed within four weeks thereafter.
Let rejoinder to the same be filed within four weeks.
If the LAC wishes to file a reply to the applications, it may do so within the same timeframe.
